facts.text: bath_temperature reads IN_PV_00, external_temperature IN_PV_02, and set_point_1 reads IN_SP_00 and writes OUT_SP_00
The tango server publishes the bath temperature and the external PT100 temperature in degC
Set point 1 is the working temperature set point of channel 1, published in degC
A set point is written with two decimals ('{:.2f}')
start() writes OUT_MODE_05 1 and stop() writes OUT_MODE_05 0
The protocol idles the line 250 ms after a command and 10 ms after a query
The tango server maps status codes 0 and 2 to STANDBY, 1 and 3 to RUNNING and a code below 0 to ALARM
The active set point channel is 1 to 3
